scenes.title: Hralgar’s Warning
scenes.rationale: The opening conversation is one continuous situation in the upper chamber.
scenes.overview: Hralgar asks for his eyes and warns that his dreams will become dangerous.
scenes.transitionToNext: Kenzo remains with Hralgar while the others begin searching below.

scenes.title: Searching the Tower
scenes.rationale: The parallel searches, book research and comparison of letters share the goal of understanding the binding and missing eyes.
scenes.overview: Footprints, books, looted rooms and old letters reveal the tower’s history.
scenes.transitionToNext: Delwath teleports through the door that the searchers could not open.

scenes.title: Eudomes’s Sealed Chamber
scenes.rationale: Entry, investigation, the mirror vision and escape from the sealed room form one distinct obstacle.
scenes.overview: Delwath finds magical objects; Seeker shrinks the door to extract him and the finds.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party returns to the platform to dislodge the iron sphere.

scenes.title: The Sphere and Its Guardians
scenes.rationale: The sphere experiment and both phases of the resulting uninterrupted fight belong together.
scenes.overview: Heat and chilled water free the sphere, provoking steam and dust attackers.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the summoned creatures defeated, the party returns to Kenzo and discusses leaving.

scenes.title: Hralgar Slips Away
scenes.rationale: The delayed departure, failing lucidity and dangerous escape form one continuous situation.
scenes.overview: Kenzo builds a mental bridge; the others drop the sphere before fleeing into the storm.
scenes.transitionToNext: They emerge from the storm into morning on the far side of their camp.

scenes.title: Dawn and Parting Ways
scenes.rationale: The morning return, private planning, questioning of Vola and farewells resolve the expedition and set the next destinations.
scenes.overview: The party returns to Vola, withholds Hralgar’s secret and parts from her and Riswynn.
